The primary endpoint was safety and immunogenicity, with variable success across arms. 4. POPULATION EFFECTS: Clear dose-response relationship across adjuvant combinations, with arm D (full combination) showing the strongest CD4+ response (15 participants) compared to simpler combinations. 5. CONFOUNDERS: This is a dose-escalation/combination-finding study with small sample size (48 total) and short duration (12.1 weeks). The mixed results across arms suggest the trial successfully identified optimal combinations rather than representing a clear failure.
